label: Nov22OECDScout
body: INDEPENDENT LIVE DASHBOARD REPLICATION: Nov22OECDScout installed Chromium/Selenium and routed blocked PBI POSTs through a local TLS reverse proxy to a fake blob.core.windows.net host mapped to the PBI IP. On exact page 22, SVG focus aria-labels and visible tooltips show: Czech 9.69; Hungary 9.91; Poland 16.38; Slovak Republic 14.59; Slovenia 23.13. Querydata raw values match. Dashboard client uses two decimals; XLSX cells only display one decimal. Screenshot/DOM captured. Our earlier padded answers likely wrong.
